description: Aggressive read timeout from configuration causes premature failures for slightly slow but healthy APIs.
remediation_recommendation: Increase `request_timeout_seconds` to 3.0-5.0s and add retry/backoff for ReadTimeouts using a limited retry loop.

description: No retry/backoff in the vulnerable path leads to transient failures becoming user-visible errors.
remediation_recommendation: Use a limited retry with exponential backoff for read timeouts; avoid retrying on ConnectionError and handle HTTP errors separately.

description: Chained calls without failure isolation cause downstream calls to fail when upstream is slow or unavailable.
remediation_recommendation: Isolate upstream failures with fallbacks, circuit breakers, or continue-on-failure for non-critical downstream tasks.
